chapter: Early years and arriving in New York
title: Working with his wife Dottie
summary: Dottie played with Benny Goodman at Basin Street East and with Marian McPartland, and they worked occasional quartet gigs.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans

blocks.x: New York had a very active recording scene at that time.
And were you working with your wife at that time?

We did do some work together. She played with us, Dottie played with us with Benny Goodman for two weeks at the Basin Street East. And then later on she played with Marian McPartland, I used to go and sit in with them sometimes. And occasionally we worked some quartet gigs here and there you know.
